newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche Babcock sells units for 180 mln DM.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche Babcock sells units for 180 mln DM.

text.p: Deutsche Babcock AG said on Friday it had sold its 50 percent stake in Velan Inc of Canada to its partner the Velan family.
It also said Clyde Blowers Plc of Glasgow had agreed to buy Bergemann GmbH and its U.S. unit Bergemann USA Inc, which are subsidiaries of Deutsche Babcock Energie- und Umwelttechnik AG.
The two transactions will bring Deutsche Babcock 180 million marks in revenues, of which 110 million marks will be booked by the September 30 end of the current fiscal year, the company said.
The moves are part of a restructuring to spin off non-core businesses, it said.
